description: §55.17.3 step 4: once every bound validated value is valid, the gated form's submit runs the author's onsubmit (calls 1). The twin of forms-gate-invalid-blocks-submit — together they prove the gate blocks on validity, not on every submit.
rationale: §55.17.3: "4. Otherwise proceed. Run the author's `onsubmit` (if any); the native submission proceeds unless that handler prevents it."
